rule.title: FAIR Act - Prohibited Algorithmic Pricing Practices
rule.requirement: It is unlawful and a violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act for: (a) a rental property owner, agent, representative, or subcontractor to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or exchange consideration for the services of a coordinator; (b) a coordinator to facilitate an express or tacit agreement among rental property owners restricting competition regarding residential dwelling units, including by performing a coordinating function; (c) two or more persons to engage in or facilitate parallel pricing coordination; (d) any agent, representative, or subcontractor of a coordinator to engage in parallel pricing coordination; or (e) any person to perform a coordinating function.
rule.interaction: A violation constitutes a violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act, P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.). Section 5 provides that the act does not limit the application of sections 6 through 17 of P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-6 through 9-17) to a violation of section 4. Section 6 provides that the act is in addition to the New Jersey Antitrust Act and prohibits municipalities from enacting conflicting ordinances.
